note: Trusted, committed SQL. build_data.py runs each query with Python's standard sqlite3 module over the two loaded tables at build time (read-only connection). The page shows the text and the result; it does not execute SQL.

tables.runs: slot, run, scenario, seed, state, model, sample_period_s, declared_mean_wind_ms
tables.measurements: slot, i, t_s, wind_ms (NULL when missing), power_kw (proxy), state, fault (0/1)

queries.title: Samples, gaps and means per run
queries.sql:
SELECT r.slot AS slot, r.scenario AS scenario, COUNT(*) AS samples,
       SUM(m.wind_ms IS NULL) AS missing_wind,
       ROUND(AVG(m.wind_ms), 3) AS mean_wind_ms,
       ROUND(AVG(m.power_kw), 3) AS mean_power_kw
FROM measurements AS m JOIN runs AS r ON r.slot = m.slot
GROUP BY r.slot, r.scenario
ORDER BY r.slot

queries.title: Machine state share per run
queries.sql:
SELECT m.slot AS slot, m.state AS state, COUNT(*) AS samples,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM measurements AS x WHERE x.slot = m.slot), 1) AS share_pct
FROM measurements AS m
GROUP BY m.slot, m.state
ORDER BY m.slot, samples DESC

queries.title: Mean power proxy by 1 m/s wind band (all runs)
queries.sql:
SELECT CAST(wind_ms AS INTEGER) AS wind_band_ms, COUNT(*) AS samples,
       ROUND(AVG(power_kw), 3) AS mean_power_kw
FROM measurements
WHERE wind_ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY wind_band_ms
ORDER BY wind_band_ms
